When a caption presents multiple Chinese strings near each other (a short label vs. a longer descriptive/flavor-text phrase), use clip_qa to determine which one is the actual proper-noun name — don't guess based on which substring 'sounds like' a name.

Once a time window returns literal query-term hits (e.g. '碧尘' appearing directly in the row), trust and use that hit rather than continuing to search farther-away windows and settling on a later, unrelated match.
